notes: Human (left) hand, entering from the upper left. Provenance: started from round-1 LEFT_HAND_SPEC in src/hand/skeleton.ts, re-read against aes-ref/alpha-white-geom.PNG on 4-8x zoomed crops (the step-2 start pose); calibrated in log-v2 step 2 (2026-09-21/22) and recalibrated on the step-3 builder (2026-09-23/25, D17/D18/D23-D25). Digit names follow user decision D2 (documentations/log/log-v2.md): THUMB = the digit with the large nail facing the viewer, coming diagonally out of the base of the palm (tip ~(562,458), D13); PINKY = the short leftmost digit curled under the palm, pointing back toward the wrist, tip ~(438,438); MIDDLE and RING = the two curled digits between, tips ~(601,523) and ~(532,505); INDEX = the extended digit reaching the contact point, tip (786,416). CALIBRATED: every joint px and r and the shape controls fitted to assets-source/reference/left-mask.png with a surrogate of build_hands.py's own SDF (minimum of the field along the camera ray through each pixel centre; Levenberg-Marquardt on the edge offset at every reference edge pixel, tighter at the fingertips) and checked with Blender builds, under anatomical constraints: every joint within 3x its keypoints.json uncertainty (D16); radii taper base->tip; hinge anatomy (D23): every finger's MCP a flexion of its metacarpal with |abduction| <= about 6 deg, PIP and DIP bends in P1's hinge plane, the knuckles on a transverse line (12 deg off the lateral axis). Step-3 controls (D17): the index knuckle (head_back 0.77, knuckle_rise 0.27, phalanx_base 0.83); forearm sag on the dorsal and palmar lines; a dorsal wrist bump; a palm heel; the first dorsal interosseous; thenar 0.90; the hypothenar from 0.30 of the way to the little-finger knuckle; a thinner metacarpal base; the wrist crease fillet and the thumb root cap refitted with the thumb. D18/D23: the middle and ring fingers flex toward the palm at the MCP in their hinge planes (MCP flexion 31 / 48 deg); 3D P1/P2 1.21 / 1.46. THUMB (D25, one bounded refit): thumb_cmc near its reading (0.8 u), the metacarpal leaving the base of the palm toward the camera, sideways bends MCP 11 deg / IP -5 deg (MCP flexion 37 deg, so the phalanges lie nearly parallel to the image plane), the IP on its reading (3D P1/P2 1.14, as drawn), the tip moved back onto the drawn thumb end (the verifier's e7); the thenar, palm heel and wrist crease refitted to the palm-heel outline. The thumb's frame is rolled 95 deg from the dorsal (thumb_roll_deg, D24) so the thumbnail faces the viewer as drawn (D2), 8 deg from the camera direction. RECONSTRUCTED (not observable in one view): z depths (index and thumb toward the camera, ring and pinky away, consistent with the drawn overlaps), flat, and dorsal: with the knuckle row as drawn and hinged fingers the back of the hand faces up and about 17 deg away from the camera. The forearm px lies outside the frame so the arm leaves the frame.
